name: kubescape
title: Kubescape
description: Kubernetes posture scanner. KUBESCAPE_SCAN_TARGET picks what to scan — valid values: cluster (live cluster via kubeconfig) | framework (a single framework against the cluster) | control (a single control). Cluster mode needs a kubeconfig inside the container at KUBESCAPE_KUBECONFIG; manifest mode scans the YAMLs at KUBESCAPE_MANIFEST_PATH. KUBESCAPE_FRAMEWORK picks the rule pack — valid values: nsa | mitre | cis | armobest | devopsbest | soc2. KUBESCAPE_CONTROL_ID runs a single control (e.g. C-0001).
